_comment: Curated UTD19 intersections for real-data CNN retraining (Day 2 of thesis sprint). Each entry maps one synthetic-equivalent intersection to a UTD19 city + four directional detector ids. Pick ~30 intersections with all four detectors available; mark missing approaches as null for 3-leg sites. The detector ids must match the values in UTD19's detectors_public.csv (TODO(utd19-cols): verify column name). Optional posted_speed_kph / is_signalized / n_approaches override the sampled Tagum-priors meta for that intersection (use when you actually know the value, e.g., from city signal databases).
